system.description: Automatically active whenever you are Earth Melded, letting you move through earth, sand, or gravel as if swimming through water (dense obstacles like rock, cement, or water block passage). You gain a supernatural sense of your underground surroundings out to 50 yards, though you cannot truly see. Underground combat requires an extra bid Physical Trait from all involved, and chases are decided by comparing Physical Traits (or Celerity, if present). This power also lets you surprise a target by rising up silently behind them, though an expecting target may win a Mental Challenge to avoid being caught off guard.
